stories.title: Binance says deposits now beat withdrawals as more tokens reopen
stories.summary: Binance's latest withdrawal phase began at 04:00 UTC today, bringing back 51 tokens on Ethereum and Solana, and the exchange says hourly deposits now exceed withdrawals. Its SAFU emergency fund is still about half spent, and several networks have not reopened. North Korea has denied the FBI's claim that it was behind the hack.
points: Restored today: 31 more Ethereum tokens and 20 Solana tokens, including LINK, SHIB, ONDO, BONK and TRUMP; still to come are BNB Chain, XRP Ledger, Sui, Arbitrum, Optimism, Tron and Base, per crypto.news.
Binance says hourly deposits have exceeded withdrawals since about 03:00 UTC on 3 Nov, per Altcoin Buzz.
Binance's own data shows $10.97B withdrawn and $5.695B deposited from 1 to 3 Nov, a net outflow of about $5.3B, per Altcoin Buzz.
The SAFU fund holds about 7,500 BTC, down from about 15,000, with no refill timeline, per Cointelegraph.
North Korea called the FBI's attribution "absurd rhetoric", per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose money again and Coinbase gets a downgrade
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had about $399M of net outflows on Monday, and ether funds lost money for a sixth straight session. Bitcoin dipped to about $76,300 in the European morning before steadying near $76,900, on track for a fifth weekly loss as chip stocks and an Apple warning weighed on markets.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs: -$398.6M on 2 Nov, with BlackRock's IBIT at -$405.3M and Fidelity's FBTC at +$6.7M, per CoinCentral citing Farside.
Ether ETFs: -$139.7M on 2 Nov, mostly from BlackRock's ETHA (-$138.3M), per CoinCentral.
Bitcoin was near $76,900 at about 11:30 UTC after a low near $76,300, per CoinDesk; liquidations over 24 hours were $382.6M, per the same report.
Morgan Stanley cut Coinbase to underweight and its price target to $120 from $258, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Americans vote in the midterms today after heavy crypto spending
stories.summary: Control of Congress is decided today, and the result shapes whether a US crypto market-structure law passes soon or starts over. Crypto super PACs spent heavily, mostly backing Republicans, while prediction markets favour Democrats. First results arrive early Wednesday Bangkok time.
points: The three leading crypto super PACs spent nearly $170M, with Fairshake at about $154M, per CoinDesk.
Polymarket gave Democrats about 69% to win the Senate and 94% the House, per Newsquawk.
The CLARITY Act passed the House 294-134 but failed a Senate vote to open debate, 49-50, per Tokenist.
First polls close at 6:00pm ET (06:00 Wed Bangkok) and the last, in Alaska, at 1:00am ET (13:00 Wed Bangkok), per 270toWin.

briefs.title: Mercado Bitcoin hacked
briefs.summary: Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin estimates about $38M was affected, while Chainalysis puts it near $49M across 17 chains; about $11M has been blocked and services are suspended, per The Cryptonomist.

briefs.title: Elliptic: $2.85B of Binance hack funds frozen or seized
briefs.summary: Blockchain analysis firm Elliptic says $2.85B of the stolen funds has been frozen or seized, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Binance warns of withdrawal scams
briefs.summary: Binance warned users about fake offers of priority processing and fake compensation claims during the reopening, per CoinCentral.

briefs.title: Tether says it holds 150,000 BTC
briefs.summary: Tether's CEO says it holds about 150,000 BTC, roughly 50,000 more than its Q3 reserve report implies, per Cryptonews.

briefs.title: Liquid's bitcoin token fully backed again
briefs.summary: The Blockstream-led Liquid sidechain restored 1:1 backing for LBTC, nearly two months after an exploit drained about 4,000 BTC, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Record month of ether ETF outflows
briefs.summary: Ether ETFs lost $1.61B in October, a monthly record, per CoinCentral.
